title: Classify actual /52 inverse residues and denominator13 applicability
body:
The denominator-13 paired sampler leaves actual inverse residues and causal availability open. This package resolves that source-domain obligation for modes 0/1 of the retained 112-owner `/52` inverse: every pair modulo 52 occurs even with owner inputs in `{-1,0,1}`, while the direct denominator-13 probability ABI applies exactly to the index-16 input sublattice with both numerators divisible by four.

The minimal nonzero l1 witness is `x=e_0`, yielding `(1/52,1/52)`; `x=-e_0` has upper-floor flags `(51/52,51/52)`. The actual kernel collects all eight original numerators before rounding or writing owners, so there is a source-bound nonadaptive arithmetic window. The package also proves an explicit conditional adapter law with independent two-bit selectors, including endpoint dispatch. Its four extra prefix bits do not establish savings, bounded latency, physical integration or reversible cleanup.

Scope: a written all-input algebraic proof with finite source-binding corroboration, not a deterministic-kernel defect, new inverse, supplier admission or κ. Pending predecessors PR6072 (`9011bf83e85ecd0443c789cf03259442f750877d`) and PR6068 (`689e28282fd5259dec7f75b83904617dab2d7b3a`) are exact contextual citations, not hidden Git-history dependencies. Scientific inputs are pinned to canonical main `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`.

Validation at `e56f5094c83f3e514d9936fa7b1c8027745a0a00`:

- Python 3.12 registered normal and optimized checks pass: all 2,704 bound-one realizations, 169 denominator-13 pairs/144 nonzero table pairs, 43,264 conditional branches, 417 signed cases, 15 actual-kernel fixtures and eight rejection controls.
- Committed-byte and source-history checks pass.
- Official export integrity and read-only Git-free normal/optimized replay pass; export files remain unchanged.

Physical K wrappers, dispatch, movement, scratch/stopping-record cleanup, guard propagation and the complete caller budget remain open. No heavy/native/selected replay or formal proof-kernel review was run.

[Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/6073#discussioncomment-19234406). Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit zxv's PR6072/6068; JoyboyBrian's PR5037/5069; Dillon's PR4933 mode/normalizer lineage; Dugongue/mdumitrean's PR4929; Nick Petalas's PR6026 and the retained native, Clifford, precision, ownership and compiler contributors. Frozen sources remain unchanged.
